description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 24.06.2019 to 30.06.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and contains regulatory information about rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a legal/regulatory instrument that modifies existing customs regulations by setting new exchange rates and rescinding previous ones, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
